run_align_pauses: run align_pauses to find optimal pause alignment between source and target utterance pause lists
run_compute_pause_alignment_metrics: run compute_pause_alignment_metrics to align pauses across source and target utterance pairs and compute quality scores
create_CompareUtterancesConfig: create a CompareUtterancesConfig dataclass to configure source and target paths, pause thresholds, and output paths
run_aggregate_pause_alignment_statistics: run aggregate_pause_alignment_statistics to compute mean and weighted mean duration and alignment scores from a pause-level DataFrame
run_main_cli: run the main CLI entry point with hydra to compute pause alignment metrics from source and target TSV files
